sources.title: parth2204aa/Diffusion_Model_QA_Dashboard - GitHub
sources.snippet: Diffusion_Model_QA_Dashboard Diffusion Model QA Dashboard is a visual tool to evaluate and monitor the quality of image outputs generated by diffusion models. It supports automated and manual QA through metrics, comparisons, prompt tracking, and failure case analysis, helping improve model performance and reliability.

sources.title: Gemini Diffusion — Google DeepMind
sources.snippet: Gemini Diffusion Our state-of-the-art, experimental text diffusion model Large-language models are the foundation of generative AI today. We're using a technique called diffusion to explore a new kind of language model that gives users greater control, creativity, and speed in text generation.

sources.title: A comprehensive survey on diffusion models and their applications
sources.snippet: A Diffusion Model (DM) is a type of generative model that creates data by reversing a diffusion process, which incrementally adds noise to the data until it becomes a Gaussian distribution.
